card.name: Body positioning instructions before body parts
card.fires_on: Small words like "the" or "of" (and the middle of "ipsilateral") in instructions about positioning the patient or raising a body part, right before a body part such as ear, legs or arm.

modes.label: Lie with the ear
modes.description: "the" after "lie with" in ear-drop instructions, before the affected ear.
modes.example: The patient should lie with<< the>> affected ear upward, and then the drops

modes.label: Elevation of the legs
modes.description: "of" or "the" after "elevation" in low blood pressure support advice, before legs or extremities.
modes.example: For hypotension, consider intravenous fluids, elevation<< of>> the legs, and an inotropic vas

modes.label: Imaging positioning
modes.description: Words in patient positioning for breast imaging, before arm or head.
modes.example: position the patient prone with the isol<<ateral>> arm comfortably above the head, shoulders flat

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward the body-part or side word that comes next in positioning directions.
card.plain: It fires on little words in directions for how to place or raise a patient's body, just before the body part is named.
